purpose: Machine-readable statuses for the gates NO automated run can decide. FINAL_REPORT.md and the derived milestone status read this file; nothing in the report or in source hardcodes these values (revision-6 repair, M-2 / R6-J).
rule: A gate here counts as satisfied only when its status is PASS, SATISFIED or MEASURED. Any other value — including a missing or unreadable file — leaves the milestone blocked. No value in this file may be set by an automated run: each is recorded by the party named in determinedBy, and the recorder is stated.
statusPolicy: When the automated gates are not all passing the milestone status is `M1_BLOCKED — IMPLEMENTATION AND EVIDENCE REPAIRS REQUIRED`. When they are, the status is the `milestoneStatusWhenUnsatisfied` of the unsatisfied external gate with the lowest priority number. When every gate of both kinds is satisfied the status is `M1_ALL_GATES_SATISFIED`. The implementation never selects the string itself.

independentClosureAudit.milestoneStatusWhenUnsatisfied: M1_BLOCKED — IMPLEMENTATION AND EVIDENCE REPAIRS REQUIRED
independentClosureAudit.determinedBy: two independent audits: a structural code audit and an AFE-Δ evidence and claim audit
independentClosureAudit.note: Revisions 1 through 5 each returned BREAKS-FOUND, and in every case a green in-house suite coexisted with real defects. No automated pass is self-certified: until an independent closure audit of revision 6 says otherwise, the milestone stays blocked for implementation and evidence repairs. This gate is why a green suite does not by itself move the status.
independentClosureAudit.recordedBy: implementation, stating that the audit has not been performed
